+    title: apiTask.title,

SUBJECT: Durable Digest: March highlights and upcoming events
WHEN: 2026-03-26T17:32:26Z
SENDER: [EMAIL community@temporal.io NAME  TELEGRAM_TAG ]
PARTICIPANTS: [EMAIL maxim.r.ivanov@gmail.com NAME  TELEGRAM_TAG ]

TEXT:
Highlights from March include new product updates, hands-on tutorials, and builder spotlights from folks pushing Temporal in creative directions. You’ll also find answers to real questions from the field and a few chances to catch us live.

 For more information and other things we’ve been working on, just keep reading! And as always, we’d love to hear from you. Feel free to share feedback in our Community Slack <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRupTCX7Zf6hdwo99Im70ZvL72Jze-jx2BVua4Lxl-k2yxBEfSVnaAHS1CyAGOvI9hloidsbx1eY=>.
Lots of big launches this month. Here’s what’s new:


	- Task Queue Priority and Fairness <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRYUhJa5FkHHyNFbDfphPauOtaesx2cel6qc8T7D1IOovGc5pfI-vGObfyVyxOHWfBN5zdzU3jBk=> are now in Public Preview. You can now specify the order in which Tasks are dispatched on the Queue based on Priority, and you can set Fairness keys to ensure an equitable spread of compute across multiple Task types.
	- Standalone Activities <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRbjppzvk4wzSgNhYEPtDFJuN6gyzMqUMsyE4BzUQnR0_Ou0whCqFgll6InFk9EOjcRPyV4kczZQ=> are now in Pre-Release! Temporal Activities can now be used on their own, outside of a Workflow as well as within one, so you can write an Activity once and use it anywhere. Get started in Go <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRT3Iody_laACr5oDfMF8gudL-XrblxK5FEDETDR8cxTqmWi81U_9VNy4xyhh4NnyI1YPV3cV3oI=> and Python <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRVnzy7s040HzXClLJ7-n-jUP1Xi4V8ZReEDcihtxl000qaXlIr0egkjxq6pC_IrW3KDityKT7sM=>.
	- Our new Temporal Developer Skill <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRhdhrMjBNdPGeAvNqVzfcylT12ohzH1pjbjXp44Yl-b4pFO9Sx8v7jn8M6OFKu82mIdGr2GAn7s=> guides your coding agents to write better Temporal code. It ensures your agents follow Temporal best practices and make fewer errors. We recommended the Skill for everyone using a coding agent.
	- Worker Versioning <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRQxnF5FnfIUIUkm7bt4SsjfBAnb6YGYYntQZ5I8UfKjDn5FrfqBH19QrIGLleGLX9N3o6IeJr8o=> is now Generally Available! This robust set of dev tools helps you avoid breaking existing Workflows during deployment. Included in this release is the Public Preview version of the Upgrade-on-Continue-as-New <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RReMLOe0GWnW3zi_gaX7xKMZ5uF3SXmnbKaJv5mHfQwUuejNL1pOT9dJaOXZNjTawNY3QryMX_I8=> and Worker Controller Autoscaling <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRXGgKCq0yaRfVk03FyQnU5qCyBl_Vi_Blw0qhSu078c325hdrEiVt9va8IEwx513dLt6E9C6544=> capabilities.
	- Namespace Endpoints <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRT7AnWP_5orpKkPVFNqHoSP4Zqrs19YGIgZl9RdE_w7XIL0Y8cjG0T789KM5zdy8UsVjgQ6CYM0=> are now available for all Namespaces, including those with High Availability enabled and those using API keys. It’s our recommended endpoint for the best developer experience.
Connect with our team to see demos from real humans. We’d love to show you exactly how we’re powering mission-critical systems at world-class organizations. That includes Replay ‘26 <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRg65ldSdiI7KbuufOYng6yvOHAkadtKvSatka0z8xqoKwACBaLnkDW7SI0HrSYRxZZP_YR_uqbs=>, our annual conference, where All Time Low is headlining the afterparty. If you know, you know. If you don’t, look up “Dear Maria, Count Me In.” You’ll get it. Use code ZIGGY75 for 75% off.


	- April 2-3, MCP Dev Summit | New York, NY <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRRXTwgcNlm6YN7RUi3pVjwCHsBswNDs_5pwKlFWQm8dIBXQ-T_YJDF54eCNhIOtL5TOMHz1bWms=>
	- April 14, Temporal Engineering Happy Hour | San Francisco, CA <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRQzsEN2VzNEWt_e0JbelAnrETOk6k_wE1IK7qZDQzfXJxzQIKmeugPd6Zu_3YzMHYOIhCyqjK04=>
	- April 22, AWS Summit | London  <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRdT8SJQZLYyUc8_heS-X-OP9H5hY0KL6Q1NLP_u-KtaEujYOW-U3_XhEizcZl1eXusfTG7211zc=>
	- April 22-24, Google Cloud Next | Las Vegas, NV <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRQesCvAsVQiKxqD10FE2B5F3TNp3MoULkjkF8z-tZRQXp4FFm14yYncmr-mdNiVJPnPv6Q41XTo=>
This month we’ve got some new additions to the Temporal Code Exchange <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRTxHhMvUIgbK5BHRnKKeKIAFt8IPhMiB7d1x30NTcSxA9UEcODXI-gnmc7oEFOzEDmaWarf6lco=>! This is a collection of code samples, example apps, and ideas to inspire you to build fun things with Temporal. 

One of the latest projects is a Temporal MCP Server <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRZmD2P9oreaewJJlSQKSxBcgv-5eDieDtjIiXdk2L4tewktgd19IPtiAVpJ1dVCmAgjy99z89Ck=> submitted by Mike Toscano, an engineering manager at Paylocity. The server connects AI assistants (or other MCP clients) and Temporal workflow orchestration clusters.

 “Rather than writing code or using the Temporal CLI manually, you can interact with your workflows entirely through natural language, asking your AI assistant to start a workflow, check its status, send it a signal, cancel it, or inspect its full event history.” 
Check it out <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRZmD2P9oreaewJJlSQKSxBcgv-5eDieDtjIiXdk2L4tewktgd19IPtiAVpJ1dVCmAgjy99z89Ck=>!
Enabling platform engineering with Temporal: Five practical use cases <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRQ63kMghf57Yw8kdNmSFzumTNsaI_ZivGvjh5sdj1BLNOm9g_7KukuZEDjShIUdWJd-PwDGjzWQ=>. From incident response and certificate rotation to CI/CD and internal platforms, see how teams replace brittle scripts with reliable workflows that handle retries, approvals, and long-running processes without starting over.
In the #typescript-sdk channel, community member Miquel wondered <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRYxJ0w62DpF9ar2ZTEe67Ge7_Sl2iCIcUz6nESEEYUqriqGH-KgSaGP_5woS4lWfQuyp82TVRCk=>, “Can you shrink a 15 MB Workflow bundle without splitting into multiple Workers?” The Worker was consuming too much memory, much of it related to modules 
that weren’t even being used. Miquel discussed ideas for reducing memory usage with Roey and James from Temporal’s engineering team, ultimately deciding on a lazy loading approach. Miquel later documented the details <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRVhUpcJIONw033s6gJ_qJ3-rGCbKnEUqPw0rOGWmLMPSfDY0eI-HcZ5sARn-tWTS-GVi0aL0Em8=> in a blog post.

 Community member Francesco Berni reported <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRXq-ZkrVLtCyLCQSZny8gpTdzxyEzipoU3Bm9z5ZaCo84o52BLnzHvHKoclUneUkBPeqx2OJZwg=> in the #operations Slack channel that his custom claim mapper wasn’t being invoked, leaving the authorizer without any valid claims. Temporal engineer David Reiss explained that the claim mapper is only called if there's a client certificate or authorization header present. After evaluating the server configuration, Francesco found that setting the requireClientAuth parameter to true fixed the problem.

SUBJECT: Durable Digest: March highlights and upcoming events
WHEN: 2026-03-26T17:32:26Z
SENDER: [EMAIL community@temporal.io NAME  TELEGRAM_TAG ]
PARTICIPANTS: [EMAIL maxim.r.ivanov@gmail.com NAME  TELEGRAM_TAG ]

TEXT:
Highlights from March include new product updates, hands-on tutorials, and builder spotlights from folks pushing Temporal in creative directions. You’ll also find answers to real questions from the field and a few chances to catch us live.

 For more information and other things we’ve been working on, just keep reading! And as always, we’d love to hear from you. Feel free to share feedback in our Community Slack <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRupTCX7Zf6hdwo99Im70ZvL72Jze-jx2BVua4Lxl-k2yxBEfSVnaAHS1CyAGOvI9hloidsbx1eY=>.
Lots of big launches this month. Here’s what’s new:


	- Task Queue Priority and Fairness <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRYUhJa5FkHHyNFbDfphPauOtaesx2cel6qc8T7D1IOovGc5pfI-vGObfyVyxOHWfBN5zdzU3jBk=> are now in Public Preview. You can now specify the order in which Tasks are dispatched on the Queue based on Priority, and you can set Fairness keys to ensure an equitable spread of compute across multiple Task types.
	- Standalone Activities <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRbjppzvk4wzSgNhYEPtDFJuN6gyzMqUMsyE4BzUQnR0_Ou0whCqFgll6InFk9EOjcRPyV4kczZQ=> are now in Pre-Release! Temporal Activities can now be used on their own, outside of a Workflow as well as within one, so you can write an Activity once and use it anywhere. Get started in Go <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRT3Iody_laACr5oDfMF8gudL-XrblxK5FEDETDR8cxTqmWi81U_9VNy4xyhh4NnyI1YPV3cV3oI=> and Python <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRVnzy7s040HzXClLJ7-n-jUP1Xi4V8ZReEDcihtxl000qaXlIr0egkjxq6pC_IrW3KDityKT7sM=>.
	- Our new Temporal Developer Skill <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRhdhrMjBNdPGeAvNqVzfcylT12ohzH1pjbjXp44Yl-b4pFO9Sx8v7jn8M6OFKu82mIdGr2GAn7s=> guides your coding agents to write better Temporal code. It ensures your agents follow Temporal best practices and make fewer errors. We recommended the Skill for everyone using a coding agent.
	- Worker Versioning <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRQxnF5FnfIUIUkm7bt4SsjfBAnb6YGYYntQZ5I8UfKjDn5FrfqBH19QrIGLleGLX9N3o6IeJr8o=> is now Generally Available! This robust set of dev tools helps you avoid breaking existing Workflows during deployment. Included in this release is the Public Preview version of the Upgrade-on-Continue-as-New <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RReMLOe0GWnW3zi_gaX7xKMZ5uF3SXmnbKaJv5mHfQwUuejNL1pOT9dJaOXZNjTawNY3QryMX_I8=> and Worker Controller Autoscaling <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRXGgKCq0yaRfVk03FyQnU5qCyBl_Vi_Blw0qhSu078c325hdrEiVt9va8IEwx513dLt6E9C6544=> capabilities.
	- Namespace Endpoints <https://mkto-ab530131.com/MjUwLVdJVS0wMDcAAAGgyi0RRT7AnWP_5orpKkPVFNqHoSP4Zqrs19YGIgZl9RdE_w7XIL0Y8cjG0T789KM5zdy8UsVjgQ6CYM0=> are now available for all Namespaces, including those with High Availability enabled and those using API keys. Product Newsletter | March 2026

There's a version of diagramming where *everything just clicks.*


The node you click takes you to the line you need. The color you defined once applies everywhere it should. The AI gets it right on the first pass. This month's updates are about closing the gap between the diagram in your head and the one on your screen.


**✨ Flowchart highlight sync: V**isual and syntax, always in step****


When you're deep in a complex flowchart, losing your place between the visual and the syntax is a small tax that adds up fast. 


**Highlight sync** keeps the two in step. Select a node – the corresponding code highlights. Edit the code – the node lights up. Hit "go to code" and you're there. It's two-way, it's instant, and once you've used it you won't want to go back.


[ Try synced editing](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ72ijil8NT3pk5q0lZcCDiZs/d0Bzd2uJ7on1)


**🎨******Custom styles: define once, apply everywhere****


Style drift is easy to miss until you're ten nodes in and nothing matches. 


**Custom styles** let you define a visual style once and reuse it across the entire diagram. This month: cleaner results when combining styles, hex color support for precise control, and less syntax to get there. The diagrams you were building manually now just work.


[ Try it in the editor](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7AVnkyOjYXVVpznuMVJTQC0/rqehZEgnazbl)


**🧠 **More accurate AI, private by default****


Better accuracy means less cleanup (and privacy you can count on). The **models powering Mermaid AI **got meaningfully better this month: more accurate output, fewer syntax errors on the first pass, faster responses. We also made improvements to how we handle your data – so you can diagram confidently knowing your content stays private. 


The kind of update that makes everything feel tighter without you having to do anything differently.


[ Create with Mermaid AI ](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7IIrnBf5e1BHa9b39OQj7o8/kC9PTWz-rhyF)


******🐚 ****Today's seashells **

Small things that make a real difference.


- 

[**VS Code**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Q5vpOvRjUr3KJOBwHXypQG/WRcb_aoGtPL_) **plugin (v2.5.9)**: Sign in works everywhere now (OAuth and manual token login both supported). Repair broken diagrams with Mermaid AI directly in the editor, with AI credits visible in the preview. Plus, visual diff for Regenerate and Remote Sync so you can see what changed before it does.


- 

[**Word**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7XszrcBnoyWp4TBKjAfEX2O/3wLWTTlbwJ4n)**, [**PowerPoint**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7fg3tpS9uSCaocyTW3mUEeW/1Gy4iVZcw5Dw), & [**Google Docs**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7nT7w2iVzvsMYmlcIwtjwGe/7g-y24KxuoEB) plugins:** Cleaner login, redesigned diagram cards, updated action buttons. Less noise, better feel.


- **OSS has a [**new home**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7vGByFys5PY8IwYl5q0zdsm/NzGQsZPpdufh):** The open-source library now lives at mermaid.ai – same library, better docs, faster path from bug report to fix.


**📌 What to try this week**


1. Open a complex flowchart and click a node. See where it takes you. 
2. Apply a custom style to a diagram you've been creating by hand. 
3. Re-run a prompt you've used before through Mermaid AI. The improvement is most noticeable on diagrams you already know.
Happy diagramming,
